summary: Raw file writes to the trunk checkout through host tooling are deliberately unguarded: the predecessor enforced that half in an editor-host write-interception hook, and no Concord surface can hold such a control because capability-placement section 1 offers no interception point inside another tool's write path. The operator accepted the loss on 2026-08-21 rather than shipping an editor plugin. Grant-level main-checkout refusal, the one-active-worktree-per-Project refusal, and git-fact reclamation remain in force and are not presented as equivalent. The predecessor-coverage record splits its row and cites this decision.
title: File-write trunk protection is accepted as unguarded
